description: The window stays open past the 300 s debounce: the real pause takes over (HVAC off) and the loop writes nothing. On close the thermostat gets the PLAIN 66 F and then ONE fresh step (68 F), never the stranded 70 F cap.

events.note: The hallway thermostat's own sensor: satisfied, so it will not start by itself.
Seed the door/window sensor as closed.
Day classification (cold: heat all night / hot: cool all night).
Bedtime: the sleep band is written and the sleep window (remote sensor in use) begins.
The window opens and stays open.
Bedroom cold; window still open past the 300 s debounce: HVAC is paused, no extra degrees.

assertions.reason: Precondition: the offset is at the cap.
Past the 300 s debounce the real pause takes over (HVAC off): no extra degrees into an open window.
No loop write while the window is open and the house is paused.
On close the thermostat gets the PLAIN 66 F, then ONE fresh step (68 F) -- never the stranded 70 F cap and never 66 + 2 x offset.
One step above plain, not the cap.

notes: Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md section 10), Issue #1194 increment (e). Tier A: the real ClimateAdvisorCoordinator + AutomationEngine under FakeHass/FakeScheduler (use_coordinator=true, so the sleep-sensor listener and the 1-minute timer are real); every assertion is track=integration for that reason and is evaluated, not skipped.

(a) Effectiveness: scratch-copy mutation run of this scenario against the production code (worktree untouched). It FAILS when M01: the whole offset deleted (the write path adds 0 and the check is a no-op); M02: the +4 F cap removed; M05: the whole gate predicate deleted (always PROCEED). Passes unmutated.

(b) Docs <-> production alignment: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Remote-sensor outer loop on the thermostat setpoint (Issue #1194, increment a)': 'Gates' table, door/window pause row and the 'Plain target / one fresh step' note. Matches production.
(c) Occupant outcome if this regressed: The sleeper must not come back to a thermostat parked at +4 F from before the window opened, nor to a doubled offset.

verdict.summary: Pause, then a clean exit: plain target plus one fresh step.
verdict.observed_behavior: No set_temperature while paused; on resume 66 then 68; 70 not before 21:35.
verdict.expected_behavior: Offset forgotten while the gate is closed; one fresh step on exit.
